```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(vegan)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggh4x)
library(patchwork)
library(Maaslin2)

plot_dir <- here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Plots")
maaslin_dir <- here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Maaslin2")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(maaslin_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# Set plot themes

```{r theme}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")

class_colors <- c(
  "Aminoglycoside"            = "#C49135",
  "Amphenicol"                = "#2D6A8A",
  "Beta-lactam"               = "#0F4C81",
  "Folate pathway antagonist" = "#5B5F97",
  "Fosfomycin"                = "#765D9A",
  "Glycopeptide"              = "#B5525C",
  "Ionophores"                = "#9A648D",
  "Lincosamide"               = "#83558A",
  "Macrolide"                 = "#D35D90",
  "Nitroimidazole"            = "#C46D4A",
  "Oxazolidinone"             = "#D17A45",
  "Phenicol"                  = "#E0A458",
  "Pleuromutilin"             = "#4F6D9A",
  "Polymyxin"                 = "#A98467",
  "Pseudomonic acid"          = "#6B6D76",
  "Quinolone"                 = "#346B5B",
  "Rifamycin"                 = "#4C956C",
  "Streptogramin A"           = "#7D8597",
  "Streptogramin B"           = "#8E6B55",
  "Tetracycline"              = "#789447")

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30"),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),

```


# Data

```{r load data}
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(log10_depth = log10(reads))
cpm <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "cpm_gene_GPH.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% rename(gene = gene_family)
phenotypes <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "phenotypes_cluster.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(antibiotic_class = gsub("Tetracyclines", "Tetracycline", antibiotic_class))
```


```{r description}
n_gene <- unique(nrow(cpm))
n_db_genes <- length(unique(phenotypes$gene_family))
n_db_cluster <- max(phenotypes$cluster) + 1
n_db_cluster_genes <- n_distinct(phenotypes$gene_family)
mean_genes <- cpm %>% column_to_rownames(var="gene") %>% t() %>% {rowSums(. > 0, na.rm=TRUE)} %>% mean()

cat("Total of", n_gene, "different genes in", ncol(cpm) - 1, "samples.\n")
cat("\tMean:", round(mean_genes)," different genes in each sample \n")
cat("Represent", n_gene / n_db_cluster_genes * 100, "% of the total genes in clustered db.\n")

```
# Antibiotic class analysis

```{r antibiotic class}
gene_classes <- phenotypes %>%
  select(gene_family, antibiotic_class) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(antibiotic_class, delim = ",") %>%
  mutate(antibiotic_class = str_trim(antibiotic_class)) %>%
  distinct(gene_family, antibiotic_class) %>%
  rename(gene = gene_family)
 

cpm_class <- cpm %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -gene,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "CPM") %>%
  left_join(gene_classes, by = "gene",relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(sample_id, antibiotic_class) %>%
  summarise(class_CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(sample_id, diet_group),
            by = "sample_id")
```


```{r plot class}
plot_class_CPM <- cpm_class %>%
  mutate(antibiotic_class = forcats::fct_reorder(antibiotic_class,
                                                 class_CPM,
                                                 .fun = median,
                                                 .desc = FALSE),
         diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = c("Omnivore",
                                               "Vegetarian",
                                               "Vegan"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = antibiotic_class,
             y = class_CPM,
             color = antibiotic_class)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 0.85,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = antibiotic_class),
              shape = 21,
              colour = "black",
              width = 0.18,
              size = 1.7,
              alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap2(~ diet_group,
              nrow = 1,
              strip = strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c("Omnivore" = "#2864A5",
                                                                          "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
                                                                          "Vegan" = "#B36B32"),
                                                                 colour = "black"),
                                   text_x = elem_list_text(colour = "black",
                                                           face = "bold",
                                                           size = 11))) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
                     breaks = c(0, 100, 1000, 10000),
                     labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors,
                    name = "Antibiotic class") +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors,
                     guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "ARG CPM") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2,
                             byrow = TRUE,
                             override.aes = list(shape = 22,
                                                 size = 3,
                                                 colour = "black",
                                                 alpha = 1)))
plot_class_CPM
```

# Gene level anaysis

```{r top 15 genes}
cpm_gene <- cpm %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -gene,
               names_to = "sample_id",
               values_to = "gene_CPM") %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(sample_id, diet_group),
            by = "sample_id") %>%
  group_by(sample_id, diet_group, gene) %>%
  summarise(gene_CPM = sum(gene_CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(
    diet_group,
    levels = names(diet_colors)))


top15_table <- cpm_gene %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(mean_CPM = mean(gene_CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = mean_CPM,
            n = 15,
            with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_CPM))

top15_genes <- top15_table$gene
gene_levels <- rev(top15_genes)


top15_gene_data <- cpm_gene %>%
  filter(gene %in% top15_genes) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene,
                       levels = gene_levels))


top15_gene_summary <- top15_gene_data %>%
  group_by(gene, diet_group) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(gene_CPM)),
            mean_CPM = mean(gene_CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_CPM = sd(gene_CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
            se_CPM = sd_CPM / sqrt(n),
            t_critical = if_else(
              n > 1,
              qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
              NA_real_),
            ci_low = pmax(
              0,
              mean_CPM - t_critical * se_CPM),
            ci_high = mean_CPM + t_critical * se_CPM,
            .groups = "drop")




plot_gene_abundance <- ggplot(top15_gene_data, aes(x = gene,
                                                   y = gene_CPM,
                                                   colour = diet_group)) +
  # geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12,
  #                                            jitter.height = 0,
  #                                            dodge.width = 0.68),
  #            size = 1.1,
  #            alpha = 0.22) +

  geom_errorbar(data = top15_gene_summary, aes(x = gene,
                                               ymin = ci_low,
                                               ymax = ci_high,
                                               colour = diet_group,
                                               group = diet_group),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.68),
                width = 0.20,
                linewidth = 0.65,
                inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  geom_point(data = top15_gene_summary, aes(x = gene,
                                            y = mean_CPM,
                                            colour = diet_group,
                                            group = diet_group),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.68),
             shape = 18,
             size = 3.2,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors,
                      drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
                     breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
                     labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.08))) +

  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Gene abundance (CPM)",
       colour = "Diet group") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5,
                             r = 0,
                             b = 5.5,
                             l = 5.5)) +

  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1,
                               nrow = 1,
                               override.aes = list(alpha = 1,
                                                   size = 3)))

tile_width <- 0.2
tile_gap   <- 0.01
tile_step  <- tile_width + tile_gap

top15_gene_classes <- gene_classes %>%
  filter(gene %in% top15_genes) %>%
  distinct(gene, antibiotic_class) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene,
                       levels = gene_levels),
         antibiotic_class = factor(antibiotic_class,
                                   levels = names(class_colors))) %>%
  arrange(gene, antibiotic_class) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(class_number = row_number(),
         class_position = 1 + ((class_number - 1) * tile_width) + tile_gap) %>%
  ungroup()


max_class_position <- max(top15_gene_classes$class_position)

plot_gene_classes <- ggplot(top15_gene_classes, aes(x = class_position,
                                                    y = gene,
                                                    fill = antibiotic_class)) +
  geom_tile(width = tile_width,
            height = 0.9,
            colour = "white",
            linewidth = 0.1) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors,
                    drop = TRUE) +

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1 - tile_width / 2,
                                max_class_position + tile_width / 2),
                     breaks = NULL,
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = gene_levels,
                   drop = FALSE,
                   expand = expansion(add = 0)) +

  labs(x = "ARG class",
       y = NULL,) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    size = 9),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5,
                             r = 5.5,
                             b = 5.5,
                             l = 2))


# Final panel

plot_top15_genes <- plot_gene_abundance +
  plot_gene_classes +
  plot_layout(widths = c(5.5, 0.5)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",)


plot_top15_genes
```

```{r save plot 2}
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "ARG_genes_by_diet_color.png"), plot_top15_genes, width = 7.5, height = 5, dpi = 600,
       bg = "white")
```

# Maaslin analysis

Gene level analysis

```{r gene metadata}
# Metadata
metadata_maaslin <- metadata %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group,
                             levels = c("Omnivore",
                                        "Vegetarian",
                                        "Vegan"))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")


# CPM genes
gene_maaslin <- cpm %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()

common_samples <- intersect(
  rownames(gene_maaslin),
  rownames(metadata_maaslin))

gene_maaslin <- gene_maaslin[common_samples,,drop = FALSE]

metadata_maaslin <- metadata_maaslin[common_samples,,drop = FALSE]
```

```{r  gene prevalence filter}
prevalence <- colMeans(gene_maaslin > 0)

gene_maaslin_filtered <- gene_maaslin[
  ,
  prevalence >= 0.10,
  drop = FALSE
]
```

```{r Maaslin2 gene-level}
fit_gene <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = gene_maaslin_filtered,
  input_metadata = metadata_maaslin,

  output = file.path(maaslin_dir, "Gene"),

  fixed_effects = c("diet_group"),

  normalization = "NONE",
  transform = "LOG",

  reference = "diet_group,Omnivore",

  standardize = FALSE,

  min_prevalence = 0)
```

```{r Maaslin2 gene-level adjusted}
fit_gene <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = gene_maaslin_filtered,
  input_metadata = metadata_maaslin,

  output = file.path(maaslin_dir, "Gene_adjusted"),

  fixed_effects = c(
    "diet_group",
    "sex",
    "age",
    "bmi",
    "log10_depth"),

  normalization = "NONE",
  transform = "LOG",

  reference = "diet_group,Omnivore",

  standardize = FALSE,
  plot_scatter = FALSE,
  plot_heatmap = FALSE
)
```


Class level analysis

```{r class metadata}
class_maaslin <- cpm_class %>%
  select(
    sample_id,
    antibiotic_class,
    class_CPM
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = antibiotic_class,
    values_from = class_CPM,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")

common_samples <- intersect(
  rownames(class_maaslin),
  rownames(metadata_maaslin)
)

class_maaslin <- class_maaslin[
  common_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

metadata_class <- metadata_maaslin[
  common_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
```


```{r class prevalence filter}
class_prevalence <- tibble(
  antibiotic_class = colnames(class_maaslin),
  prevalence = colMeans(class_maaslin > 0)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(prevalence))


keep_classes <- class_prevalence %>%
  filter(prevalence >= 0.10) %>%
  pull(antibiotic_class)

class_maaslin_filtered <- class_maaslin[
  ,
  keep_classes,
  drop = FALSE
]
```

```{r Maaslin2 class-level adjusted}
fit_class <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = class_maaslin_filtered,
  input_metadata = metadata_class,

  output = file.path(maaslin_dir, "Antibiotic_class"),

  fixed_effects = c(
    "diet_group",
    "sex",
    "age",
    "bmi",
    "log10_depth"
  ),

  normalization = "NONE",
  transform = "LOG",

  reference = "diet_group,Omnivore",

  standardize = FALSE,

  min_prevalence = 0,
  plot_scatter = FALSE,
  plot_heatmap = FALSE
)
```

# Summaries read by the manuscript

The class ranking uses the median CPM across all participants, the order of the class plot above. A gene
conferring resistance to several classes counts in each of them.

MaAsLin 2 applies Benjamini-Hochberg across every feature and every fixed effect, covariates included (61 gene
families × 6 coefficients). That is the q reported. As a sensitivity analysis the correction is repeated within the
diet-group coefficients only (61 families × 2 contrasts); both are exported.

```{r summaries}
class_ranking <- cpm_class %>%
  group_by(antibiotic_class) %>%
  summarise(median_CPM = median(class_CPM), mean_CPM = mean(class_CPM),
            prevalence = mean(class_CPM > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(median_CPM)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())
class_ranking

gene_adjusted <- read_tsv(file.path(maaslin_dir, "Gene_adjusted", "all_results.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
maaslin_diet_only <- gene_adjusted %>%
  filter(metadata == "diet_group") %>%
  mutate(q_maaslin_all_terms = qval,
         q_diet_terms_only = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
  select(feature, value, coef, stderr, pval, q_maaslin_all_terms, q_diet_terms_only) %>%
  arrange(q_diet_terms_only)
cat("Tests in the MaAsLin family:", nrow(gene_adjusted), "| diet-only family:", nrow(maaslin_diet_only), "\n")
maaslin_diet_only %>% filter(q_diet_terms_only < 0.25)

write_tsv(class_ranking, here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Tables", "arg_class_ranking.tsv"))
write_tsv(top15_gene_summary %>% left_join(top15_table %>% rename(overall_mean_CPM = mean_CPM), by = "gene"),
          here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Tables", "arg_top15_families.tsv"))
write_tsv(maaslin_diet_only, here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Tables", "maaslin_gene_diet_only_bh.tsv"))
```
